summary: Learn to assess partner controls, reconcile transfers and document cash-assistance evidence. Explore the course and strengthen your assurance practice.
lede: Cash and voucher assurance helps programme, finance, MEAL and compliance staff check delivery controls and trace supporting evidence. It builds practical skills in mapping controls and partner risks, reconciling payment records, reviewing complaints and post-distribution findings, and documenting exceptions in an audit trail for programme and finance decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for checking cash and voucher delivery, partner controls, accountability evidence or financial records. It suits intermediate practitioners with experience in humanitarian programming, finance, MEAL, compliance or audit who need to connect operational evidence across those functions.
modules: CVA Risk Assessment and Control Mapping
CVA Assurance Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with cash or voucher delivery, humanitarian finance, MEAL, compliance or audit processes is expected. No coding or programming is required; basic spreadsheet use is helpful for reconciliation exercises.
